summary: Connect brand evidence, delivery choices and leadership reviews in five days. Explore the course outline and plan your team's next steps.
lede: Brand management training helps brand, marketing, product and customer-experience professionals turn customer and market evidence into brand and delivery decisions. Participants scope a brand audit, interpret equity signals using Keller’s CBBE and Aaker’s Brand Equity models, prioritize audience segments, and identify gaps across customer touchpoints. They also build an Excel scorecard, assign governance roles and prepare a leadership review and action plan, with portfolio and governance covered at foundation level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape brand direction, measure customer response or coordinate how brand promises reach the market.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with marketing, customer-facing work or product decisions is useful. No coding is required; bring a laptop with Excel available for the scorecard exercise.
